# Synthetic calibration data

**This is not production data.** `arrivals.csv`, `service_times.csv` and `observed.json` were generated by
`validation/make_calibration_example.py`, which simulates a known system once with SimPy (8 workers, lognormal service
time with mean 0.35 s and standard deviation 0.20 s, arrivals at 8/s, then 20/s from 300 s, then 8/s from 600 s). Because
the truth is known, the repository's tests check that `surgesim fit`, `fit-arrivals` and `calibrate` recover it.

`model.json` was built only from the fitted numbers plus the known worker count. See
[docs/calibration.md](../../docs/calibration.md).

```bash
surgesim fit examples/calibration/service_times.csv --scale 0.001
surgesim fit-arrivals examples/calibration/arrivals.csv --window 30
surgesim calibrate examples/calibration/model.json --observed examples/calibration/observed.json --sensitivity 5
```
